limitations: QGramm-only basic encrypted attachment acceptance; competitors do not implement this file API
Synthetic reproducible payload; 1MiB plaintext chunks plus28B AESGCM overhead
Resume drops idle HTTP pooled connections between successful requests; no midrequest/server crash
Upload wall time includes checksum refusal, exact chunk retry, status resume and completion; generation excluded
